rows.label: Formula
rows.text:
$\sin^{-1}x + \cos^{-1}x = \frac{\pi}{2}$ and $\tan^{-1}x + \cot^{-1}x = \frac{\pi}{2}$ for $x$ in the domain.
$\tan^{-1}x + \tan^{-1}y = \tan^{-1}\frac{x+y}{1-xy}$ when $xy < 1$.
Principal value ranges: $\sin^{-1} \in \left[-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right]$, $\cos^{-1} \in [0, \pi]$, $\tan^{-1} \in \left(-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right)$.
